description: Source code implementing CAN communication interface for Linux, including socket creation, binding, message transmission, reception, and version info retrieval.

methods.name: Can_Init
methods.description: Initializes CAN controllers by creating and binding sockets based on configuration.

methods.name: Can_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes CAN controllers by closing sockets and resetting states.

methods.name: Can_SetControllerMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: Can_Write
methods.description: Transmits a CAN message through the specified hardware handle.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Write
methods.description: Placeholder for periodic write tasks (not used in demo).

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Read
methods.description: Reads incoming CAN messages and invokes reception indication callback.

methods.name: Can_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of the CAN module.
